name: ZTE Corporation
summary: ZTE Corporation provides integrated information and communication technology solutions in the People's Republic of China, rest of Asia, Africa, Europe, America, and Oceania. It operates through three segments: Carriers' Networks, Consumer Business, and Government and Corporate Business. The Carriers' Networks segment provides wireless and wireline access, bearer systems, core networks, server and storage, and other technologies and product solutions. The Consumer Business segment focuses on the development, production, and sale of home information terminals, smart phones, mobile internet terminals, and fusion terminals, as well as provides related software application and value added service…
